text:
Yes, there are several. The right one depends on your Model Y's model year.

## 2020 to early-2025 Model Y: plug-in rear display
These 8-9 inch Android screens mount on the back of the center console. They work while driving and add rear climate and seat-heat controls.

- **Teslahubs Rear Display Ultra** is the cheapest at $269.99 (list $449.99) and fits 2019-2024. It supports Netflix, YouTube and Disney+. [Dealectric's comparison](https://dealectric.com/tesla-model-y-back-seat-screen) lists it, but I don't have a direct Teslahubs product link.
- **TESERY 8.66"** costs $359 and fits Model Y 2020 to 2025.03. It supports CarPlay and installs yourself. [Buy here](https://www.tesery.com/products/tesery-8-66-inch-rear-entertainment-display-screen-for-tesla). Reviews are mixed: one buyer reported lag, and another said the screen keeps locking into child mode and apps won't finish updating. Others said it's fine for kids.
- **Amazon options** run about $210-$330, mostly 8.66" Android 13 units with wireless CarPlay and AC/seat-heat control. Ratings are middling, around 3.5-3.9 stars. [Browse them here](https://www.amazon.com/tesla-model-y-back-seat-screen/s?k=tesla+model+y+back+seat+screen). Check that the listing covers your exact year.

## 2025-2026 Model Y (refresh)
Most trims already include Tesla's own 8" rear touchscreen, and the add-on displays above were made for the older console. Your options are:

- **Seat-back tablet mount** (TESERY, $19.99) is the cheapest fix and works while driving. Check your trim against TESERY's compatibility list, since it doesn't fit the Performance or Standard.
- **Standard trim without a rear screen:** Hansshow's H86 ($399.99) is the option.
- **Parked movie nights:** The [Aurzen TravelPlay AutoCinema screen](https://dealectric.com/go/aurzen-travelplay-autocinema-tesla-model-y) is $119.99. It's a clip-in projector screen and sunshade for the roof or rear window. You need a separate projector, such as the [Aurzen ZIP](https://dealectric.com/go/aurzen-zip-tri-fold-mini-projector) at $199.99. Don't use it while driving. Dealectric lists code CJ10 for about $12 off. That link is an affiliate link, so Dealectric earns a commission. Aurzen's own page is [here](https://aurzen.com/products/aurzen-travelplay-autocinema-screen-for-tesla-model-y).

## My pick
- **Kids watching on the road in a 2020-2024 car:** the Teslahubs Ultra, because it's the cheapest and fits that range. Buy from a seller with a good return policy, given how mixed the aftermarket reviews are.
- **2025-2026 car:** start with the $19.99 tablet mount and your own tablet.

What year and trim is your Model Y, and is this for driving or for parked viewing? I can narrow it down once I know.

Sources: [Dealectric comparison](https://dealectric.com/tesla-model-y-back-seat-screen), [TESERY](https://www.tesery.com/products/tesery-8-66-inch-rear-entertainment-display-screen-for-tesla), [Amazon results](https://www.amazon.com/tesla-model-y-back-seat-screen/s?k=tesla+model+y+back+seat+screen), [Aurzen](https://aurzen.com/products/aurzen-travelplay-autocinema-screen-for-tesla-model-y)
